mapper.select: SELECT writeoff_id, ar_id, receipt_id, writeoff_amount, writeoff_date, period, dept_id, user_id, create_by, create_time, remark FROM fin_ar_writeoff WHERE ar_id = #{arId} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY writeoff_id
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(writeoff_amount), 0) FROM fin_ar_writeoff WHERE ar_id = #{arId} AND del_flag = '0'

SELECT bad_debt_id, company_id, provision_no, period, ar_id, partner_id, partner_name, receivable_amount, provision_ratio, provision_amount, provision_type, dept_id, user_id, create_by, create_time, remark FROM fin_bad_debt
AND period = #{period}
AND del_flag = '0'
ORDER BY bad_debt_id DESC
